trigger: Gate 3 / 5090 Blackwell Code Review Failure (STATUS: REJECT)
raw_compiler_output: - Point 1: ColonyHospitalitySystem allocates ezDynamicArray in constructor and uses heap reallocations.
- Point 2: Bed indices use unchecked array indexing without runtime bounds validation.
triage_diagnosis:
Root Cause: High-performance simulation systems must enforce zero-allocation semantics on bounded domains. Using ezDynamicArray introduces malloc/free cycles. Array access lacked production bounds validation.

Minimal Repair:
Migrate to ezStaticArray<T, N> with EZ_ASSERT_ALWAYS bounds checks and provide non-throwing TryGetBed() accessors.
learned_invariant: SKILL-008: In hot subsystems with bounded domains, use ezStaticArray to ensure zero heap allocations, enforce bounds via EZ_ASSERT_ALWAYS, and provide non-throwing TryGet accessors.
